From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@cobaltsys.com>

Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@cobaltsys.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:06:37 -0800
Subject: URGENT — venue access blocked (overnight tunnel flooding)

Diego — sorry for the last-minute heads up. Overnight storm caused flooding in the underground tunnel that provides primary access to the Harbor Convention Center. Building security evacuated the site this morning and the conference center is closed for an assessment.

We have two options on our side:
1) Move the session to our Downtown HQ at 212 Market St (smaller room, capacity ~25).
2) Convert the workshop to a hybrid format: key Cobalt execs in person (CEO + 2), remainder on Zoom / live stream.

We can make space at Downtown HQ but we need confirmation from Redwood on hybrid support (stream, mics, two-way AV) and an updated agenda within the next 90 minutes so we can notify our execs. We realize many of you are already en route.

I’m attaching the incident memo and building note for your ops team.

—Sarah
Sarah Jensen
Head of Executive Events, Cobalt Systems
Attachment: cobaltsys_venue_incident.pdf (application/pdf)

Sarah — thanks for the update and the memo. We can absolutely support option (2) (hybrid) and can also accommodate the Downtown HQ if you prefer a small in-person contingent. Proposed plan: 

- Keep the timeline but shift locations: meet at Downtown HQ, 212 Market St, 1st Floor — Room 3. New in-person start 13:30.
- Streaming fallback: Redwood will provide live Zoom + RTMP stream, on-site AV engineer (we'll bring an external mic cluster and a Qualcomm streaming box).
- Agenda: move customer Q&A earlier to 14:45 so remote execs can participate. Updating and attaching agenda (updated_agenda_v2.pdf) and hybrid ops checklist (hybrid_instructions.txt).
- Travel ask: if any of our team are still in transit and can’t make 13:30, we’ll log them in as remote presenters.

Please confirm which option you prefer (Downtown in-person for a 20–25 person subset vs. full hybrid). Once you confirm we’ll send an updated calendar invite and push the Zoom link.
